Jinzhen Wang 王金震

Assistant Professor of Computer Science
University of North Carolina at Charlotte
Director, HPDi Lab

Google ScholarCVjwang96@charlotte.eduWoodward Hall 210B

I am an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science at UNC Charlotte, where I lead the High-Performance Data Intensive (HPDi) Lab. My research focuses on high-performance computing and scientific data management, with an emphasis on data reduction, compression, and parallel and distributed systems.

I received my Ph.D. from the New Jersey Institute of Technology, advised by Qing Liu, and my bachelor's degree from Shandong University. I was a research intern at Los Alamos National Laboratory from 2022 to 2023. I am also affiliated with the High Performance Computing and Systems Lab at UNC Charlotte.

Prospective students: We welcome inquiries from students interested in high-performance computing and scientific data management. Explore HPDi Lab.
